new_packages.label: הִרְהוּרֵי עַכּוּ"ם וְאָחוֹר בְּאָחוֹר
new_packages.qualifies_because: Three bechina-connected concepts forming an independent thematic domain — the evil-polarity mirror of Package 1 (עולה ורוח נשברה). These concepts share the essential nature of 'the state of spiritual falling and estrangement from God that necessitates the עולה'. The bechina chain: נפילה מן המדרגה ↔ הרהורי עכו"ם (explicit: 'זֶהוּ בְּחִינוֹת הִרְהוּרֵי עַכּוּ"ם') and אחור באחור (the named state: face turned away from God, who also turns away). All three are different expressions of the same negative spiritual reality: the experience of mid-prayer collapse and God-estrangement. They meet the 3+ node threshold for a NEW_PACKAGES_PROPOSED verdict.
new_packages.independence_argument: This evil-pole cluster does not exist anywhere in the current dataset for Torah #108. The dataset currently represents only the good pole (Package 1: the remedying act). The evil pole — the state of spiritual fall that the עולה corrects — is a structurally independent domain with its own internal bechina connections. It is not a subset of Package 1 (which is good-polarity) but its exact mirror: same Torah, same axis, opposite orientation. The specific Breslovian redefinition of 'הרהורי עכו"ם' as 'falling mid-prayer' (not foreign idol-worship) is a unique conceptual contribution of this Torah that requires independent representation.

observations:
Torah #108 is an 8-line teaching with a tight binary structure: there is a state of spiritual fall (הרהורי עכו"ם / אחור באחור) and there is the remedy for it (עולה / רוח נשברה / נסירה). The dataset currently captures only the remedy side (Package 1 in torah_108_packages.json). The teaching requires a second package — the evil-pole mirror — to be complete.

The new package (108-A) qualifies for NEW_PACKAGES_PROPOSED because:
1. It contains 3+ concepts with explicit bechina language ('זֶהוּ בְּחִינוֹת הִרְהוּרֵי עַכּוּ"ם' for the fall; 'נִמְצָא הוּא אָחוֹר בְּאָחוֹר' for the estrangement state)
2. It represents an independent thematic domain (evil/deficiency pole) not covered by any existing package
3. It is structurally necessary: the Torah's argument is precisely the movement FROM this evil state TO the good state via the עולה/נסירה mechanism

The causal flow (eitza) of Torah #108 runs:
  [Pkg 108-A: evil] → eitza via קלקול האמונה → produces → [need for Pkg 1: good]
  [Pkg 1: good] = the עולה/נסירה/שם חת"ך = repairs → back to [Pkg 108-A's opposite: פנים בפנים]

Note on 'הרהורי עכו"ם': This is one of the most distinctive aspects of Torah #108. The Rebbe explicitly redefines a Talmudic legal category (Kiddushin 40: 'God does not join an idolatrous thought with action') in psychological-spiritual terms: any person who begins to pray or do hitbodedut with devekut and then falls mid-way has experienced 'הרהורי עכו"ם' — the thought-pattern of idol-worship. This is not about actual foreign religion but about the mind's abandonment of its attachment to God. This unique redefinition makes הרהורי עכו"ם a bechina of נפילה מן המדרגה in this specific Torah context.
